<reason>A won by pinning the vote to the proposition’s own test and extracting B’s concession that no deep-space crewed mission beats probes and telescopes on science per dollar. B’s capability, cadence, and “most” burdens were real and honestly argued, but they never showed why those extra outcomes entitle crewed exploration to a majority once the expensive flagships fail the comparison. A made the choice easier: complements can be small, stations already keep people, and fragility is not a veto.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Q2 forced B to admit no deep-space crewed mission wins on science per dollar; A then used that concession to collapse B’s remaining cadence/presence defense into an exemption from the motion’s test.</best_rebuttal>
